podcast.body: This studio album was recorded at Sun Studios, featuring Jerry Lee Lewis, Carl Perkins, and Johnny Cash, with Roy Orbison filling in for the deceased Elvis Presley. While it has its moments, it is not considered a highlight of any of the participating artists' discographies. "Class of 55 has its moment, but isn't a highlight of any of those men's discographies."

srcs.source: A History of Rock Music in 500 Songs

podcast.body: An album on which Jerry Lee Lewis collaborated with Roy Orbison, Johnny Cash, and Carl Perkins. Released in 1986, it made the top 20 on the country chart and marked a significant step in Roy Orbison's career resurgence. "He collaborated with his fellow ex-son performers, Johnny Cash, Karl Perkins and Jerry Lee Lewis, on an album called Class of 55."

srcs.source: A History of Rock Music in 500 Songs
